label: Bible Study
prompt: And he shall be like a _____ planted by the rivers of water, that bringeth forth his fruit in his season; his leaf also shall not wither; and whatsoever he doeth shall prosper.
verse: And he shall be like a tree planted by the rivers of water, that bringeth forth his fruit in his season; his leaf also shall not wither; and whatsoever he doeth shall prosper.
note: The very first psalm sketches the righteous as a riverside tree — Jeremiah borrows the picture later.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: And the LORD was with Joseph, and he was a _____ man; and he was in the house of his master the Egyptian.
verse: And the LORD was with Joseph, and he was a prosperous man; and he was in the house of his master the Egyptian.
note: Sold by his brothers and stuck in Egypt, Joseph still had the one thing that mattered: the LORD was with him.

label: Sunday School
prompt: By faith Moses, when he was born, was hid three months of his parents, because they saw he was a _____ child; and they were not afraid of the king's commandment.
verse: By faith Moses, when he was born, was hid three months of his parents, because they saw he was a proper child; and they were not afraid of the king's commandment.
note: Moses' parents hid him three months because they saw he was a 'proper child' — the KJV's word for a fine baby.

label: Deep Water
prompt: For there is nothing hid, which shall not be _____; neither was any thing kept secret, but that it should come abroad.
verse: For there is nothing hid, which shall not be manifested; neither was any thing kept secret, but that it should come abroad.
note: Spoken right after the lamp-under-a-bushel saying: what's hidden now is only waiting for daylight.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: And though I bestow all my goods to feed the poor, and though I give my body to be burned, and have not charity, it _____ me nothing.
verse: And though I bestow all my goods to feed the poor, and though I give my body to be burned, and have not charity, it profiteth me nothing.
note: Even giving everything away, even martyrdom, without love adds up to zero: 'it profiteth me nothing.'
